[[Team Flare Secret HQ]] }} '''The Aegislash Agenda''' (Japanese: '''ギルガルド、惑わす''' ''{{tt|Gillguard|Aegislash}}, Bewilder'') is the 555th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the seventh chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Viola]] challenges {{adv|X}} to a battle and loses. * {{adv|Trevor}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Y}} go over Viola's photos to find clues. * Y finds {{adv|Shauna}}, but notices her strange behavior. * X reveals how he obtained his [[Mega Ring]]. * Under the control of [[Celosia]], Shauna steals [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]]'s [[Kangaskhanite|stone]]. * After being caught, Shauna attacks Y, only for Viola to push her out of the way and take the attack. * The strain of the mind control causes Shauna to faint. * With the stone in hand, Celosia escapes with X pursuing her. * X is helped by a [[Korrina|girl]] and her {{TP|Korrina|Lucario}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Lucario}} ([[Mega Evolution|Mega Lucario]]) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|X}} * {{adv|Y}} * {{adv|Trevor}} * {{adv|Tierno}} * {{adv|Shauna}} * [[Viola]] * [[Korrina]] (silhouette) * [[Xerosic]] * [[Celosia]] * [[Bryony]] * [[Mable]] * [[Aliana]] * [[Gurkinn]] (silhouette;
